projects.title: Small-Image Classification Capstone
bullets: Trained a compact image classifier using Python and PyTorch as a contribution to a supervised undergraduate capstone team project.
Applied simple input transformations and summarized classification errors while examining small-image classification under input changes.

projects.title: Image Input Transformations Course Project
bullets: Loaded public small-image datasets using Python for a supervised graduate course project on classification under input changes.
Applied simple input transformations to the small-image datasets as part of the supervised course project.

research.title: Static Checks for Example Programs
bullets: Parsed small public example programs using Python and abstract syntax trees as a student assistant contributing to supervised faculty research.
Wrote checks for selected code patterns and documented false-positive cases in static checking of small programming exercises.
